context.project_goal: MASTER QA SUITE: a cloneable, portfolio-grade Selenium+Pytest framework with self-generated wiki, Streamlit runner, and CI matrix (local & Sauce).
key_rules: Preserve docstring headers; they feed docs sync
Follow folder layout: tests/, pages/, utils/, tools/, ui_streamlit/, docs/wiki/
Use WebDriverWait over sleep; robust click with JS fallback is allowed

hints.tests: Prefer parametrization & fixtures; no global state.
hints.ui_streamlit: Stateless; read run args and spawn pytest via subprocess.
